# Video Assets

This directory contains video assets for the YORCH website.

## Required Videos

The following video files are referenced in the application:

- `hero-bg.mp4` - Background video for the Hero section
- `brand-manifesto-bg.mp4` - Background video for Brand Manifesto section
- `experiences-bg.mp4` - Background video for Experiences section
- `academy-bg.mp4` - Background video for Academy section
- `hull-cutting.mp4` - Background video for Footer section
- `ocean-eclipse.mp4` - Video for Ocean Eclipse yacht
- `black-sovereign.mp4` - Video for Black Sovereign yacht
- `azure-horizon.mp4` - Video for Azure Horizon yacht
- `membership-tour.mp4` - Video tour for Membership section

## Notes

- All videos should be optimized for web playback
- Recommended format: MP4 with H.264 codec
- Recommended resolution: 1920x1080 or higher
- Ensure videos are muted and looped for background use
